name: punk-ip-article-illustrations
title_zh: 角色定妆照先于文章，插图全按它来演
tagline_zh: 先锁定角色，再出插图，不许中途换脸
tagline_en: Upload one photo to mint your own IP character (with a four-view sheet), then send that character into every article you write — retro flat-3D vignette style, image count auto-scaled to article length.
desc_en: Punk 出品的完整个人 IP 插图工作流：从用户上传的人物照片创建、修订、确认并持久化可复用角色，也可直接启用内置 Punk 角色；角色确认后读取完整文章、Markdown、网页、帖子或观点，自动决定数量并生成复古彩色扁平 3D 小剧场正文插图。适用于创建个人 IP、角色设定板、切换角色、文章自动配图、长文多图、流程拆解图和核心动作图等连续任务。
why_zh: 从照片做出能反复用的角色，再进插图工作流。脸漂了就重来。
why_en: Nails a real creator pain — not another article-illustrator, but a way to establish your own visual persona first, then reuse it across every piece. One consistent "you" running through all your content is a recognition moat. Photos stay local; no sensitive-attribute inference.
limit_zh: 不是一次性贴纸。要每张换人，卸掉。
limit_en: The character stays locked until you explicitly confirm it — drafts can't be activated, and handing it an article won't skip that gate. With no image tool on the host it returns prompts instead of pictures. Character packs stay local only.
title_en: Lock the character look first, then illustrate every.
